programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: Season 4 Finale Special: Check Up with Dr. Drew Part 1
programmes.d: Dr Drew hosts the cast in front of a live studio audience and discusses Jenelle's ongoing battle with addiction. Kailyn struggles to stay calm when Dr Drew attempts to make peace with Jo's girlfriend.
Maci takes Bentley to a counselor, Catelynn and Tyler reunite with Carly, Mackenzie gets devastating news, Cheyenne addresses Taylor's racist tweets, and Amber is arrested.

programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: Check Up with Dr Drew Part 2
programmes.d: In part two, Dr Drew hosts the cast of Teen Mom 2 and examines Chelsea's on again, off again relationship with Adam while Leah talks about finally settling down with Jeremy and reveals some big news.

Amber is released from jail. Mackenzie finds out that Josh cheated on her. Maci's son can't go to Jagger's party. Cheyenne's boyfriend moves to LA, but his housing puts strain on their relationship. Catelynn has a surprise for her and Tyler's anniversary.
Dr Drew hosts a look back at the hilarious highs and the difficult lows never before seen with Kailyn, Leah, Jenelle and Chelsea from the fourth season of Teen Mom 2.

Jenelle finds out she's pregnant and decides to terminate her pregnancy. Kailyn has her baby shower. Leah struggles with Ali's medical diagnosis. Chelsea deals with Adam having another baby. (S5, ep1)
Catelynn, Maci and Cheyenne travel to Indiana for Amber's court hearing, Mackenzie questions her relationship with Josh, and producers try to get Andrew's side of the story.

programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: Love Will Never Do Without You
programmes.d: Jenelle recovers from her abortion and meets a new guy. Chelsea has her first day of Esthetician School. Kailyn and Jo fight about her move to Delaware. (S5, ep2)
Catelynn and Tyler debate bailing their friend Ashley out of jail, Mackenzie questions staying with Josh, and Maci wants to turn Chattanooga, TN, teal for PCOS Awareness Day.

programmes.t: Teen Mom UK: Next Generation: Crunch Time
programmes.d: Matt lets Angel down big time and Angel can't see a way back. Luke steps up. Isha's excited about house hunting, Jamie less so. Chloe has a breakthrough with her attachment issues.
Cheyenne, Maci and Catelynn react to the leaked audio of Amber's altercation with Andrew, Mackenzie gets a birthday surprise from Josh, and Gary lends his support to Amber.

programmes.t: Teen Mom UK: Next Generation: Point Of No Return
programmes.d: Angel's on a mission to find Matt and Whitney goes into labour. Isha's going out out but is feeling insecure about her body. Chloe lets Liz take EH out for the first time.
Maci's restraining order against Ryan is an obstacle on Bentley's birthday, Mackenzie gets an opportunity through cheer, and Cheyenne works on her event planning business.

programmes.t: Teen Mom UK: Next Generation: Newborns and New Beginnings
programmes.d: Isha's in tears over Jamie. New mum Whitney's back at her mums after putting her moving plans on hold. Ellie wants a job and walks the streets handing out her CV.
Catelynn takes her mom on vacation to address their generational trauma, Mackenzie questions renewing her vows, and Maci finds a way to help young women afford birth control.

programmes.t: Teen Mom UK: A New Chapter For Some
programmes.d: Teen Moms are back! Sassi's dreams of her future without Darren, and Mia's dreaming of an easier life with Marliya and Maggie. Amber's got her life on track, but Ste could derail things.

programmes.t: Teen Mom UK: Old Problems And New
programmes.d: Amber's problems with Ste are getting worse and Mia's worried about Marliya after she falls ill. Chloe's making sure Marley's ready to become a brother, and Sassi is chasing her dreams.
Amber opens up about a new romantic connection, Cory worries about leaving Ryder while he's on The Challenge, and Mackenzie says goodbye to her mom.

programmes.t: Teen Mom UK: Looking Forward or Back?
programmes.d: Chloe's in a celebratory mood as she finally has the baby shower. Sassi rolls up her sleeves, Amber's dealing with an old foe, and Mia tries to bury the hatchet with Maggie.
Amber's boyfriend Dimitri comes to visit, Cheyenne prepares Ryder for pre-school while Cory is on The Challenge, and Maci debates letting Bentley apply to private school.

programmes.t: Teen Mom UK: The Big Days
programmes.d: Amber and Ste have a final showdown. Meanwhile, Mia has a final showdown of her own with Maggie. Sassi's launching her brand new business. The big day has finally come for Chloe!
Cheyenne rushes Ryder to the hospital, Amber arranges for Dimitri to take a lie detector test, and a grief-stricken Mackenzie takes a business trip to Florida.
Chloe's coming to terms with life as a mum of 2. Sassi is out in the world of dating. Mia is navigating motherhood to a teenager. Amber has a new man.
Maci asks Taylor to have a talk with Bentley about respecting girls, Catelynn meets with an organic baby food company in New York, and Cheyenne is anxious about Cory's return.

programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: Keep Your Head Up
programmes.d: Leah learns that Ali will need to use a wheelchair. Jo and Kailyn fight about Isaac's scheduled drop off because Jo is late. Jenelle and her new boyfriend Nathan decide to move in together. (S5, ep3)
Cheyenne helps Cory and Taylor plan their gender-reveal party, Mackenzie works to be more organized for her kids, and Amber introduces Dimitri to her protective brother.
Jenelle moves in with Nathan in Myrtle Beach. Chelsea invites Adam to go with her to pick Aubree up from her first day of pre-school. Kailyn and Javi put an offer on a house in Delaware. (S5, ep4)
Chelsea throws Aubree's 4th birthday party. Jenelle and Nathan get excited when they think they're pregnant. Jeremy returns home to Leah and the girls after passing out at work. (S5, ep6)
Mackenzie and her family help each other heal, Cheyenne worries about how Ryder will adjust to having a half-sister, and Catelynn and Tyler look into gender selection.

programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: These Are The Days
programmes.d: Kailyn is overwhelmed and has a major meltdown. Leah and Jeremy meet with Corey and his wife to discuss Ali starting school early. Aubree meets Adam's new baby. (S5, ep7)

In the midst of COVID, Amber struggles with her long distance relationship with Dimitri when he becomes possessive. Maci puts her personal feelings aside when Bentley wants to go to therapy with Ryan.
Chelsea gets upset when Adam sends her a visitation request. Barbara and Nathan have a blowout after Jenelle has surgery. Leah and Corey support Ali on her first day of school. (S5, ep8)

Amber is shocked when Gary asks her to move onto his property. Catelynn pursues a career in microblading while Mackenzie accepts a job opportunity in Florida. Bentley starts therapy and Maci is heartbroken when she finds out he feels neglected.
Chelsea takes Aubree to her first dance class. Jenelle and Barbara argue about Barb's blowout with Nathan. Kailyn breaks down when she realizes her mum won't be at her wedding. (S5, ep9)

When Mackenzie's father needs to have quadruple bypass surgery, her plans to move to Florida are put on pause. Maci worries about Bentley's performance in school while Catelynn and Tyler contemplate having another child.

programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: Out of the Blue
programmes.d: Javi takes Isaac to Jo's for the first time. Adam responds to Chelsea's visitation objection. Ali tests out her wheelchair while Leah continues to struggle with Jeremy being away. (S5, ep11)

programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: What You See is Not What You Get
programmes.d: Kailyn's baby is born. Chelsea struggles with the new visitation agreement. Leah and Jeremy work on their relationship. Jenelle is pregnant but things are on edge after Nathan's DUI arrest. (S5, ep12)

programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: That's the Way Love Goes
programmes.d: Javi goes back to work. Jo moves to a new apartment. Jenelle worries as things with Nathan worsen. Chelsea hears major news about Adam. Leah discovers the cause of Ali's muscular dystrophy. (S5, ep13)
Javi goes back to work, leaving Kailyn alone. Jo moves. Jenelle and Nathan get worse. Chelsea hears some major news about Adam. Leah discovers the cause of Ali's muscular dystrophy. (S5, ep14)

programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: When Everything Seems Wrong
programmes.d: Jenelle and Nathan cope with his upcoming jail time. Chelsea moves into her new home. Kailyn invites Jo and Vee to Isaac's birthday party. Leah struggles to balance work and family life. (S5, ep15)
Leah starts medication for her anxiety. Kailyn and Javi visit Joe and Vee's apartment. Nathan prepares for jail and Jenelle worries about being alone. Chelsea meets with a lawyer. (S5, ep16)

programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: Harder Than It Looks
programmes.d: Jenelle struggles alone with Jace while Nathan is away. Leah and Jeremy clash over finances. Chelsea investigates Adam's legal charges from his accident. Kailyn celebrates her birthday. (S5, ep17)

programmes.t: Teen Mom 2: I'll Be Missing You
programmes.d: Leah and Jeremy visit Ali's specialist. Jenelle and Nathan are reunited. Javi leaves for a work trip and Kailyn struggles with loneliness. Chelsea receives news about Adam and her job. (S5, ep18)
Kailyn's estranged mum returns. Chelsea faces Adam at Aubree's practice. Corey's dad helps Leah with Ali's temporary wheelchair. Jenelle starts the process to get divorced from Courtland. (S5, ep19)
Adam is arrested again. Chelsea tries to cope. Leah tries to manage the growing jealousy between the twins. Nathan and Barbara clash. Kailyn struggles to explain Javi's absence to Isaac. (S5, ep20)
Jenelle and Barbara clash over Jace's behavioural issues. Kailyn struggles with the kids for Javi's return home. Leah decides to take Corey to court. (S5, ep21)
